definition: sum of the n smallest values among all n(n-1)/2 undirected Euclidean pairwise distances
node_count: explicitly selects n edges; edge order statistics and typical spacing change with n
missing_behavior: finite for nondegenerate n>=2 input; zero/duplicate-heavy inputs can collapse it

definition: minimum of all n(n-1)/2 undirected Euclidean pairwise distances
node_count: extreme statistic over O(n^2) pairs, normally decreases as n grows at fixed area
missing_behavior: finite for n>=2; equals zero when any coordinates duplicate

definition: sample SD of all undirected pairwise distances divided by their mean
coordinate_scaling: dimensionless; invariant to positive uniform scaling
node_count: no algebraic n factor, but finite-sample/distributional dependence remains
missing_behavior: undefined if mean distance is zero; finite for all TSPLIB48 aspect variants

definition: sample SD / mean of strong-component sizes in the directed 3-nearest-neighbor graph
coordinate_scaling: invariant under positive uniform scaling, except distance ties/numerics
node_count: component count/size distribution depends on n although k=3 is fixed
missing_behavior: R sample SD is NA for one component; missing on eil51 and rat195 in TSPLIB48 aspect data

definition: sample SD of the n-1 edge lengths in the Prim spanning tree
node_count: MST edge scale changes with point density and sample size n-1
missing_behavior: undefined for fewer than two MST edges; finite for audited data

definition: fraction of undirected pairwise distances strictly below their arithmetic mean
coordinate_scaling: dimensionless; invariant to positive uniform scaling
node_count: pair count changes with n; finite-sample and geometry dependence remain
missing_behavior: finite for n>=2 and all TSPLIB48 aspect data

definition: maximum minus minimum among the n-1 MST edge lengths
node_count: MST extreme range changes with density and n
missing_behavior: finite for n>=2; degenerates to zero for a single edge

definition: sample SD / mean of per-node distances to the nearest convex-hull supporting line; hull nodes contribute zero
coordinate_scaling: dimensionless; invariant to positive uniform scaling
node_count: hull size, zero fraction, and interior composition change with n
missing_behavior: undefined when mean hull distance is zero (e.g. all nodes on hull)

definition: mean of salesperson spandepth values for the Prim spanning tree
coordinate_scaling: invariant to uniform scaling, except MST ties/numerics
node_count: tree depth depends directly on tree size, topology, and implementation root

definition: median per-node distance to the nearest convex-hull supporting line; hull nodes contribute zero
node_count: hull-point fraction and interior distances change with n
missing_behavior: finite; may be zero when at least half the nodes lie on the hull
